clauses.standard_text: We collect only the data necessary to provide the service: account information, usage analytics, and content you submit. We do not sell personal data to third parties.
We share personal data only with service providers under written confidentiality obligations, and with law enforcement when legally required.
We retain account data while your account is active, and for 90 days after deletion for backup and legal compliance purposes.
We use essential cookies for functionality. Analytics cookies are opt-in. We do not engage in cross-site tracking.
A current list of subprocessors is available on our website. We provide at least 30 days' notice before adding new subprocessors.
